# repository: # repository  GitHub owner/name allowed to request publication.
# packages    comma-separated shell globs; every .deb in a release must match.
# codenames   comma-separated codenames this producer may publish to; also the
#             default when a request names none.
# attested    yes: every .deb must carry a GitHub build-provenance attestation
#             from this repository's tag workflow (gh attestation verify).
# notify      comma-separated repositories sent a `build` dispatch after a
#             successful publish, or - for none.
# component   main or image: the one component this producer's packages go to
#             (core ADR-0059). Every codename it lists must publish that
#             component. image is for builds that replace a Debian package of
#             the same name, or depend on such a build. Changing a producer's
#             component needs the move workflow (move.yml) right after the
#             merge: until it runs, the producer's publications fail closed.
# Add a producer only after confirming the package names it ships.
frostyard/updex
# incus versions carry -debian13-, which is not a ~debNN marker, so they
# would route to every target: trixie only until they carry ~deb13/~deb14.
# Not attested: it releases from pushes to stable, so its provenance names
# refs/heads/stable rather than the release tag that fetch-release.sh checks.
# image (core ADR-0059 step 5): Debian 13 ships incus, incus-base,
# incus-client and incus-extra (trixie-security), and the 1: epoch makes these
# builds replace them; incus-ui-canonical goes with them, one producer.
frostyard/incus
# Static Go, attested from v* tags; registering attested=yes also refuses the
# unattested nightly `dev` prerelease, whose 1.0.0.dev version sorts above releases.
frostyard/intuneme
# Static Go. frostyard-firn-gui (firn ADR-0021) loads GTK 3, Pango and Cairo
# with dlopen and declares no Depends; trixie and forky ship the same sonames.
frostyard/firn
# GTK4/libadwaita are loaded at runtime (puregotk, no Depends): trixie until a
# forky smoke test passes.
frostyard/chairlift
# Python, Architecture: all, built and tested on trixie only so far.
frostyard/first-setup
# bootc (Rust) and libostree-1-1 (C) link trixie's libraries, so their versions
# carry ~deb13. trixie only until a ~deb14 forky build exists, which must also
# sort above forky's own libostree-1-1 (2026.4-1). Exact names, not libostree-*,
# keep it from shadowing Debian's other libostree packages.
# Not attested: it releases from manual workflow_dispatch runs on main, so its
# provenance names refs/heads/main rather than the release tag.
# image (core ADR-0059 step 5): this libostree-1-1 replaces Debian's, and
# bootc links against it.
frostyard/bootc-debian
# The packages of snosi's moonlight and voxtype sysexts (core ADR-0066). The
# ten other omarchy-apps names left the build with snosi's flurry desktop; a
# release that still holds one is refused. Exact names. Built in debian:trixie
# against trixie's libraries without a ~deb13 marker, so trixie only. Not
# attested: it releases from pushes to main, so its provenance names
# refs/heads/main rather than the release tag.
frostyard/omarchy-apps
